name: Smuggler Conference
objectives: Assess Imperial coercion risk
Determine whether independent operators can coordinate without surrendering autonomy
outcome: Loose alignment formed under pressure. Trust remains narrow but real enough for future coordination.
politicalConsequences: New Republic access to fringe operators improved without formal alliance obligations.
militaryConsequences: Distributed smuggler interference complicated Imperial shipyard assumptions.

name: Bilbringi Intervention
objectives: Disrupt Imperial shipyard advantage
Prevent Thrawn from converting repair capacity into campaign permanence
outcome: Imperial command structure fractured following Thrawn's death. Shipyard advantage reduced.
politicalConsequences: Independent operators acquired leverage with New Republic leadership.
militaryConsequences: Imperial offensive tempo collapsed in the immediate term.

name: Mount Tantiss Recovery
objectives: Locate Imperial storehouse
Neutralize clone threat
Recover or destroy compromised strategic material
outcome: Storehouse access denied to Imperial command. Residual data contamination remains a live concern.
politicalConsequences: New Republic legitimacy strengthened by exposure of Imperial contingency practices.

name: Katana Fleet Acquisition
objectives: Recover lost Dreadnaughts
Deny New Republic force expansion
Rebuild Imperial operational depth
outcome: Fleet divided by discovery, interdiction, and rushed acquisition. Strategic shock still achieved.
politicalConsequences: Demonstrated that old secrets still carry present-tense power.
militaryConsequences: Temporary Imperial fleet expansion changed New Republic deployment priorities.

name: Noghri Realignment
objectives: Expose Imperial deception
Shift Noghri loyalty away from Imperial command channels
outcome: Imperial covert pressure reduced. Organa Solo's influence expanded beyond formal diplomacy.
politicalConsequences: New Republic moral authority strengthened in a strategically useful way.
militaryConsequences: Imperial assassination and abduction channels degraded.

name: Sluis Van Raid Response
objectives: Prevent Imperial capture of docked New Republic assets
Identify procedural weakness in shipyard defenses
outcome: Raid failed to secure decisive fleet control, but exposed serious procedural vulnerabilities.
politicalConsequences: New Republic confidence in rear-area infrastructure temporarily weakened.
militaryConsequences: Docking-control procedures revised across vulnerable staging facilities.

name: Nkllon Convoy Protection
objectives: Preserve Calrissian industrial output
Deny Imperial leverage over predictable cargo movement
outcome: Industrial continuity preserved with increased attention to convoy timing and route concealment.
politicalConsequences: Private industrial actors gained stronger arguments for New Republic protection.
militaryConsequences: Convoy scheduling treated as classified logistics rather than commercial paperwork.

name: Honoghr Disclosure
objectives: Expose Imperial ecological deception
Break coercive loyalty structure
Protect Organa Solo contact channel
outcome: Imperial leverage over Noghri loyalty degraded after proof of long-term deception.
politicalConsequences: Organa Solo gained a covert-aligned constituency outside formal New Republic structures.
militaryConsequences: Imperial covert action capacity reduced and partially redirected.

name: C'baoth Containment
objectives: Assess Jedi-related coercion risk
Prevent Force-user instability from controlling strategic assets
outcome: C'baoth threat removed at Wayland, but the episode demonstrated the cost of pairing unstable Force actors with military command.
politicalConsequences: New Republic sensitivity to Jedi-related intelligence increased.
militaryConsequences: Imperial command lost an unpredictable coercive tool before it could become a durable advantage.

name: Obroa-skai Archive Extraction
objectives: Authenticate archive-derived intelligence
Identify data theft patterns
Protect slicer access from political exploitation
outcome: Useful archive correlations obtained. Attribution remains sensitive.
politicalConsequences: New Republic dependence on private technical actors increased.
militaryConsequences: Archive theft indicators added to fleet-warning criteria.

name: Ferrier Asset Denial
objectives: Track stolen hull movement
Deny Imperial purchase channels
Separate genuine leads from Ferrier self-promotion
outcome: Theft routes mapped in part. Ferrier remains active and opportunistic.
politicalConsequences: Independent brokers remain exposed to guilt-by-association after Imperial procurement activity.
militaryConsequences: Recovered hull sightings weighted more heavily after Katana Fleet shock.

name: Council Friction Containment
objectives: Limit factional delay during active threats
Preserve decision speed without bypassing legitimacy
outcome: Political drag remains present but trackable.
politicalConsequences: Private intelligence increasingly values timing analysis inside New Republic process.
militaryConsequences: Operational response can be slowed by chamber dynamics even when threat evidence is strong.

name: Ukio Pressure Operation
objectives: Test New Republic response to nonconventional orbital coercion
Convert agricultural dependency into political pressure
outcome: Imperial deception briefly amplified perceived threat without requiring proportional visible force.
politicalConsequences: Civilian worlds demanded proof faster than New Republic procedure could provide it.
militaryConsequences: Counter-deception protocols became part of planetary reassurance planning.

name: Kuat Procurement Watch
objectives: Detect capital-ship demand before fleet movement
Separate commercial repair from factional rearmament
outcome: Procurement anomalies flagged. Attribution remains commercially obscured.
politicalConsequences: New Republic must monitor industrial neutrality without forcing shipyards toward Imperial customers.
militaryConsequences: Early-warning criteria expanded to include capital-component demand.

name: Bel Iblis Reintegration
objectives: Fold independent military capacity into legitimate command
Preserve rapid-response advantages without duplicating authority
outcome: Cooperation improved. Command politics remain sensitive.
politicalConsequences: Reintegration reduces fragmentation but reopens old legitimacy disputes.
militaryConsequences: New Republic gains flexible response capacity if autonomy terms remain workable.

name: Noghri Contact Protection
objectives: Protect Noghri sources after deception exposure
Keep clan contact chains from becoming public leverage
outcome: Contact chains remain viable but highly exposure-sensitive.
politicalConsequences: Organa Solo's influence extends through trust rather than treaty language.
militaryConsequences: Imperial covert channels lose secrecy as former assets become witnesses.
